phases.title: Shared InlineConfirm component (foundation)
preconditions: None — first phase, creates the new shared component from scratch
testsFirst: NEW TEST: features/lib/__tests__/integration/InlineConfirm.test.tsx — renders message+detail; cancel calls onCancel (not onConfirm); confirm calls onConfirm; shows pendingLabel while promise unresolved; rejected promise shows inline error and keeps panel open; tone='warning' applies amber confirm class; buttons have accessible names
implementationSteps: Create InlineConfirm.tsx per the documented props contract (message, detail?, confirmLabel?, pendingLabel?, cancelLabel?, tone?, onConfirm, onCancel)
Implement pending/error state internally (subsumes parent deleting/saving/isSubmitting flags)
role=group + aria-label from message; tone drives confirm-button color only (red-600/amber-600)
phases.writeBack: InlineConfirm exported from features/lib/front/components/InlineConfirm.tsx with props {message, detail?, confirmLabel?, pendingLabel?, cancelLabel?, tone?, onConfirm, onCancel}; owns its own pending/error state; import path @/features/lib/front/components/InlineConfirm for all later phases.

phases.title: Migrate Pattern-B sites (LessonCard, EvidenceListItem, QuranPage)
preconditions: Phase 1 InlineConfirm exists and exports the documented props contract
testsFirst: UPDATE TEST: LessonTaskList.test.tsx — delete-lesson cancel and confirm paths assert InlineConfirm markup replaces the card
UPDATE TEST: EvidenceListItem.test.tsx — delete-evidence cancel/confirm and error-keeps-open assert InlineConfirm markup
UPDATE TEST: QuranPage.test.tsx — delete-session cancel/confirm and error-keeps-open assert InlineConfirm markup
implementationSteps: Replace each site's local confirm-panel markup with InlineConfirm rendered in place of the card
Drop local deleting/isSubmitting pending-state flags (InlineConfirm owns pending now); keep the confirm* trigger state (confirmDelete/confirmDeleteId)
phases.writeBack: LessonCard, EvidenceListItem, QuranPage render InlineConfirm in place of the card; local deleting/isSubmitting flags removed, confirm* trigger state retained; their integration tests assert the new shared markup on cancel and confirm.

phases.title: Migrate Pattern C (AttendanceList void, ThreadView leave)
preconditions: Phase 1 InlineConfirm available; Phase 2 established the migration pattern for replacing local panels
testsFirst: UPDATE TEST: AttendanceList.test.tsx — void-record cancel/confirm paths assert InlineConfirm renders attached to the row in place of the inline button swap
UPDATE TEST: MessagingPage.test.tsx (ThreadView) — leave-conversation cancel/confirm paths assert InlineConfirm renders attached to the row
implementationSteps: Replace the inline Confirm/Cancel button-swap markup with InlineConfirm attached to the row
Drop local leaving/pending flags; keep confirmVoid/leaveConfirm trigger state
phases.writeBack: AttendanceList void and ThreadView leave render InlineConfirm attached to the row, replacing the local Confirm/Cancel swap; leaving/pending flags removed, confirmVoid/leaveConfirm trigger state retained.

phases.title: Fix #11 — ChildList archive (detached banner → attached panel)
preconditions: Phase 1 InlineConfirm available with tone='warning' support
testsFirst: UPDATE TEST: ChildrenComponents.test.tsx — archiving a learner renders InlineConfirm (tone='warning') attached to that learner's ChildCard, not a top-of-list banner; cancel leaves the learner active, confirm archives
implementationSteps: Remove the top-of-list amber banner (archiveConfirm at list level)
Render InlineConfirm tone='warning' attached to the matching ChildCard for the learner being archived
phases.writeBack: ChildList archive confirm now renders InlineConfirm tone='warning' attached to the matching ChildCard, replacing the detached top banner — fixes feedback #11 (confirm is always in view next to the clicked Archive button).

phases.title: Convert feedback admin modals to inline panels
preconditions: Phase 1 InlineConfirm available; AdminFeedbackPage selectedId/selectedRejectId trigger state unchanged
testsFirst: NEW/UPDATE TEST: AdminFeedbackPage.test.tsx — approving/rejecting a row renders InlineConfirm inline within that feedback row (message preview via detail), cancel clears selection without mutation, confirm calls handleApprove/handleReject; folds in the former RejectModal/ApprovalModal cancel+confirm assertions
implementationSteps: Replace RejectModal/ApprovalModal rendering in AdminFeedbackPage with InlineConfirm rendered within the selected row (detail = message preview)
Wire onConfirm to handleApprove/handleReject and onCancel to clear selectedId/selectedRejectId
Delete RejectModal.tsx and ApprovalModal.tsx; fold their test assertions into AdminFeedbackPage.test.tsx
phases.writeBack: RejectModal and ApprovalModal deleted; AdminFeedbackPage renders InlineConfirm inline in the selected feedback row for approve/reject, still calling handleApprove/handleReject; modal test files folded into AdminFeedbackPage.test.tsx.

phases.title: Style-guide update — InlineConfirm as the single approved pattern
preconditions: Phases 1-5 complete — InlineConfirm is the only destructive-confirm component in use across all sites
testsFirst: DOC CHECK: ui-style-guide §3 names InlineConfirm as the single approved destructive-confirmation component, with placement guidance (replace-card for Pattern B sites vs attached-to-row for Pattern C/D sites)
implementationSteps: Rewrite §3 Destructive confirmation to point at InlineConfirm as the codified pattern, replacing the prior hand-rolled-pattern descriptions
phases.writeBack: ui-style-guide §3 rewritten to document InlineConfirm as the single approved destructive-confirmation component, with replace-card vs attached-row placement guidance.

UPDATE TEST: ChildrenComponents.test.tsx — confirming archive shows a transient '<name> archived' notice near the action that auto-dismisses
